dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is flashcard management, study review, AI card generation, and podcast generation; the Python client implements matching EchoDecks API calls. It also exposes a few additional purpose-aligned commands such as creating decks, listing cards, and checking podcast status.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The documentation describes the main tools, required API key, and generation credit costs, but it could more clearly tell users that deck content, topic text, and raw text may be transmitted to EchoDecks and that mutating or credit-consuming actions should be user-directed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains SKILL.md, a Python API client, and tests. I found no installer script, startup hook, obfuscation, background worker, or persistence mechanism.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Using the ECHODECKS_API_KEY environment variable and making HTTPS requests to a fixed echodecks.com API endpoint is proportionate for this integration. The API key grants access to account data and actions within EchoDecks, so users should treat it as sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, broad filesystem access, or unrelated local data access was found. Account mutations are limited to EchoDecks study and deck workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The concern is supported as a disclosure gap: generation features can send user-provided text or deck-derived content to EchoDecks. This is expected for an EchoDecks AI-generation integration and is not hidden exfiltration, so it does not justify Review by itself.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting EchoDecks process the decks, notes, topics, and raw text you provide. Avoid using confidential, regulated, or personal material unless your use of EchoDecks permits it, and ask your agent to confirm before submitting reviews or spending credits on card or podcast generation.
llm.summary: EchoDecks is a coherent flashcard API integration, with the main caveat that user study content and credit-spending actions go to EchoDecks.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: echodecks
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is a straightforward client for the EchoDecks API. It retrieves an API key from the `ECHODECKS_API_KEY` environment variable and makes HTTP requests to a hardcoded, specific domain (`https://echodecks.com`) as defined in `echodecks_client.py`. There is no evidence of data exfiltration to unauthorized endpoints, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts against the agent in `SKILL.md`. All actions are aligned with the stated purpose of flashcard management and generation.
